meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Urban co-operative banks' priority-sector advances by sector (agriculture, micro and small enterprises, housing, education...), in ₹ crore and as a share of all their advances
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 787, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service (one grid per edition, as on 31 March; a March printed by two editions takes the later edition's figure). Table 3. All UCBs.
